occurrences.text: And when they came to Jesus, they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:
Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
